description:
Havells Aquilla 1000W dry iron is a fast-heating clothes iron built for everyday crisp shirts, smooth sarees, and wrinkle-free school uniforms. The 1000W heating power warms up quickly and spreads heat evenly, so you spend less time fighting stubborn creases. Its non‑stick coated soleplate glides easily over cotton, linen, synthetics, and delicate fabrics, helping prevent snags, shine marks, and accidental sticking.

Use the adjustable temperature dial to match the fabric, then iron with steady control thanks to the ergonomic grip and 360° swivel cord that moves with you. The bright orange body is easy to spot in your laundry area, and the power indicator adds a simple safety cue. If you want neat clothes in minutes without steam refills or extra maintenance, Aquilla is the no-fuss dry iron that gets the job done.

features: 1000W quick heating: Reaches working temperature fast, so you finish daily ironing faster—ideal for office wear and school uniforms.
Non‑stick coated soleplate: Smooth glide reduces pulling and sticking, helping protect fabrics from shine marks and accidental burns.
Adjustable temperature control: Simple rotary dial lets you match heat to cotton, linen, wool, silk, and synthetics for safer results.
Even heat distribution: Delivers consistent pressing across the soleplate for sharper creases and fewer repeat passes.
360° swivel cord: Moves freely to prevent tangles, giving better reach and control on large garments like sarees and bedsheets.
Power indicator light: Clear on/off status for safer use and quick checks before storing.
Ergonomic grip: Comfortable handle design helps reduce hand fatigue during longer ironing sessions.
